title: 1853 Copenhagen cholera outbreak
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1853 Copenhagen cholera outbreak", at revision 1332150446, opens: "The 1853 Copenhagen cholera outbreak was a severe outbreak of cholera which occurred in Copenhagen, Denmark in 1853 as part of the third cholera pandemic. It killed about 4,800 people." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4554867, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "cholera pandemic in Denmark". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
